located_observations.location: upper left photo, chair rail/post joint
located_observations.observation: One hand braces the weathered post, another grips a cobalt screwdriver whose shaft ends at the visible screw head. The adjacent wood members and contact are legible.

located_observations.location: upper center photo, patch and hands
located_observations.observation: A brick patch is stitched onto cobalt cloth. One hand holds a needle at its upper-right edge, another steadies the fabric, and a supporting hand is visible below the sleeve. A frayed opening remains beyond the patch's upper-left side, consistent with work in progress.
A folded cobalt shirt with brick patches is held by a giver and received by two open hands. Cloth folds obscure the exact tear site; color and patch treatment connect this moment to the sewing image.

Three edge-to-edge repair crops make a horizontal sequence above a centered title. The sequence remains substantive at thumbnail size, followed by a continuous invitation and two adjacent aligned information groups.

located_observations.location: title through paragraph and lower groups
located_observations.observation: The title and invitation lead directly to one full-width explanation line, then left event/date/time/place and right fee/deadline/item/URL. All entries can be found without returning to remote corners.

Hangul uses upright robust sans strokes with open counters and consistent character proportions; Latin, numbers and punctuation share clean baselines. The main title is bold sans rather than the optional serif suggested in planning.

located_observations.location: photo seams and lower white plane
located_observations.observation: Narrow straight seams cleanly separate the three crops. Daylight tones and fabric colors are coherent; printed text edges are crisp and no logo, QR, watermark or extra caption is visible.

text.raster_codepoint_limit: Observed punctuation shapes do not certify their underlying Unicode code points.

style.checked_requirement: Documentary color photo sequence with cropped shared chair/clothing repair; connected central invitation and mature upright clean Korean body.
style.observations: The photo sequence occupies the upper 47% and the whole width. Bold sans title and a single paragraph line differ from optional typographic/layout suggestions, while the chosen action sequence and reading route remain visible.

substantive_visual.observations: Chair screw fastening, fabric stitching and a patched garment handoff express shared repair through actual nonglyph scenes.

excluded_template.observations: The three close action crops carry the concept and organize the full-width seam. The lower white reading plane has aligned text, but imagery is substantive and the scene does not serve as an empty room or small decoration.

ratio.observations: Height is nearest-integer rounding within the predeclared 0.5 pixel tolerance; original bytes were preserved without resizing.

format.observations: One independent flat opaque-looking landscape poster; no mockup or multi-poster sheet.

information_relationship.observations: Photo actions → central title/English/invitation → continuous explanation → adjacent four-line event and participation groups.

hangul.observations: Meaningful word gaps remain, no isolated Hangul glyph or clipped copy observed; body counters are stable and readable at usage720.

function_contact.observations: The chair is visibly braced and the screwdriver contacts a screw; sewing needle, thread and cloth edges are identifiable; giver/receiver hands contact the folded garment. The folding prevents verification of the precise same tear position.

material_edge_finish.observations: Skin/wood/fabric textures and daylight are coherent, straight photo seams are clean and type remains flat precise print.

residuals.observation: The complete explanation is one long line across almost the full width, with smaller optical body than the invitation; it is readable at the inspected 720px view, but smaller displays were not verified.
The stitching scene still shows fraying beyond the patch, and the handed-over shirt is folded. Exact correspondence of the repaired tear is not visually verifiable from these crops.
